sections.description:
Short title extent and commencement

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan
Health Foundation Act, 1994.
(2) It extends to the whole of the Province of
Balochistan except Tribal Areas..
(3) It shall come into force at once.

Definitions

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
2. Definitions: ‑‑In
this Act, unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context:‑‑
(a) "Agency" means any department or
organization of the Provincial Government and includes a Corporation or the
body set up and controlled by the Government.
(b) "Board" means the Board of Directors of
the Foundation constituted under subsection (1) of section 5;
(c) "Chairman" means
the Chairman of the Foundation;
(d) "Committee" means a committee
constituted under subsection (6) of section 6;
(e) "Director" means
a member of the Board of Directors of the Foundation;
(f) "Foundation"
means the Balochistan Health Foundation establishment under subsection (1) of
section 3;
(g) "Fund" means a fund constituted under
subsection (1) of section 14;
(h) "Government"
means the Government of Balochistan;
(i) "Land" includes building and benefits
arising out of land and things attached to the earth or permanently attached to
earth;
(j) "Loan" means a refundable sum of money
advanced by the Foundation and an Health institution working in private sector
as specified under subsection (1) of section 13;
(k) "Managing Director" means the Managing
Director of the Foundation;
(1) "Member" means a
member of the Board;
(m) "Non‑Government Organization"
means an organization set up with private finance for providing health
facilities and to achieve the prescribed objectives of this Act;
(n) "Prescribed"
means prescribed by the rules under this Act
(o) "Rules" means the
rules framed under this Act;
(p) "Regulations"
means the regulations framed under this Act; and
(q) "Small cities"
means any city having population of less than 5,000 inhabitants. .

Establishment of the foundation

CHAPTER I
CHAPTER I
PRELIMINARY
CHAPTER II
3. Establishment of the Foundation.‑‑‑(1) There
shall be established a Foundation to be known as Balochistan Health Foundation
for carrying out the purpose of this Act.
(2) The Foundation shall be a body corporate having
perpetual succession and a common seal with power to acquire, hold and dispose
of property, both movable and shall by its name sue and be sued.
(3) The head office of the Foundation shall be at
Quetta.

Management

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER II
4. . Management: ‑‑(1) The administration
and management of the Foundation and its affairs shall rest in the Board of
Directors which may exercise the powers and do all acts and things that may be
exercised or done by the Foundation.
(2) The affairs of the
Foundation shall . be conducted subject to the supervision and control of the
Government.
(3) If any question arises as
to whether any matter is a matter of policy or not, the decision of the
Government shall be final.

Constitution of the board

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER II
5. Constitution of the Board.‑‑‑(I)
There shall be a Board of Directors of the Foundation consisting of such number
of official and non‑official members including the Chairman as may be appointed
by the Government through a Gazette notification:
Provided that the Board shall
consist of not less than six and not more than eleven members including the
Chairman.
(2) The Chairman and members
other than an ex officio member, shall unless the Government otherwise directs,
hold office for a period of three years but he may be re‑appointed as
such for another term of three years or for such shorter term as the Government
may direct.
(3) The Government may remove a member/Director on
the ground of inefficiency, unsuitability or misconduct after giving him an
opportunity of being heard.
(4) The Chairman and any member may by writing under
his hand addressed to the Government resign his office:
Provided that his resignation shall not take effect
until accepted by the Government.

Duties and functions of the chairman and members

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER II
6. Duties and functions of the Chairman and members: ‑‑(1)
The Chairman and members shall discharge such duties and perform such functions
as assigned to them by or under this Act.
(2) Until the Board is duly
constituted, the Chairman shall subject to such directions as the Government
may from time to time give, exercise the powers, discharge the duties and
perform functions of the Board
(3) No act or proceeding of the
Board shall be invalid by reason only of the existence of a vacancy in, or any
defect in the constitution of the Board.
(4) A simple majority of the
members of the Board shall constitute the quorum of the Board.
(5) The meeting of the Board
shall be held at such time and places and in such manner as the regulations may
provide:
Provided that until regulations are made in this
behalf the meeting of the Board shall be held as and when convened by the
Chairman.
(6) The Board may constitute
such financial, technical and advisory committees, as may be desired necessary
for carrying out the purpose of this Act.

Appointment and functions of the managing director etc

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
7. Appointment and functions of
the Managing Director etc: ‑‑(1) The Government shall appoint a
whole time Managing Director of the Foundation whose qualifications and terms
and conditions of service shall be such as may be determined by the
regulations.
(2) Subject to subsection (4),
the term of the Managing Director shall be three years but the Government may
extend the same for a period not exceeding one year at a time.
(3) The Managing Director shall be the Chief
Executive of the Foundation, he has to serve as member of the Board also, and
shall exercise effective control over and make all decisions necessary for the
smooth functioning of the day to day affairs of the Foundation, under the
general supervision of the Board.
(4) The Government may remove the Managing Director
on the ground of inefficiency, unsuitability, or misconduct after giving him an
opportunity of being heard.
(5) In particular and without prejudice of the
generality of foregoing powers, the Managing Director shall have the power and
responsibility to‑‑
(a) exercise administrative
control over the officers, officials of the Foundation;
(b) exercise, in respect of the
Foundation such other management, administrative and financial powers as deemed
appropriate by the Foundation;
(c) submit the annual budget
proposals of the Foundation to the Board;
(d) maintain the accounts of
the Foundation;
(e) prepare the annual report
of the Foundation for the Board and the Government;
(f) exercise such powers as the
Board may delegate to him; and
(g) act on behalf of the
Foundation in any emergency subject to the obligation to report such action to
the Board at its next meeting and to seek the Board's rectification of any
action so taken.

Recruitment, conditions of service of officers, officials etc.

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
8. Recruitment conditions of
services of officers, officials etc.‑‑‑The Foundation shall,
by regulation make with the prior approval of the Government, lay down the
procedure for the appointment of its officers and officials and the terms and
conditions of their services and shall be competent to take disciplinary action
against them, according to the prescribed rules.

Members and officers to be public servants

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
9. Members and Officers to be
public servants: ‑‑The Chairman, members, officers and officials of
the Foundation shall, when acting or purporting to act in pursuance of any of
the provisions of this Act, be deemed to be public servants within the meaning
of section 21 of the Pakistan Penal Code (XIV of 1860).

Indemnity

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
10. Indemnity.‑‑‑No
suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding shall lie against the Foundation,
the Board, the Chairman or any member, officer or official the Foundation in
respect of anything done in good faith or intended to be done under this Act.

Members officers and officials not personally liable

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
11. Members, officers and officials not personally liable: ‑‑(1)
The members, Directors, Advisors, Officers and Officials of the Foundation
shall be indemnified by the Foundation against all losses and expenses
sustained or incurred by him in the discharge of his duties save such losses
and expenses as are substantial and incurred as result of his own wilful act or
default.
(2) The Managing Director,
shall not be personally responsible for the acts of any member, Director,
Advisor, Member, Officer, or Official of the Foundation which he could not have
reasonably prevented by the due exercise of his powers and functions under this
Act and the rules and regulation, made thereunder or for any loss or expense
resulting to Foundation by reason of the insufficiency or deficiency in value
of, or title to any property or security acquired or taken on behalf of
Foundation by the wrongful act or anything done by him in good faith in execution
of the duties of his office.

Delegation of powers to chairman etc

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER III
ESTABLISHMENT
12. Delegation of Powers to Chairman etc.‑‑‑The Foundation
or the Board may by general or special order, delegate to the Chairman or a
member or any officer, official of the Foundation any of its powers, duties or
functions under this Act to such conditions or limitations as may be specified
in the order.

Functions of the foundation

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER IV
POWERS AND DUTIES OF THE FOUNDATION
13. Functions of the Foundation.‑‑‑(1) Subject to the
other provisions of this Act the Foundation shall take measures and exercise
such powers as may be necessary for the promotion, development and financing of
health institutions in private sector and for carrying out the purposes of this
Act.
(2) Without prejudice to the
generality of the functions mentioned in subsection (1) the Foundation shall:‑‑
(a) Establish or cause to be
established health institutions and such allied Projects;
(b) Give grants preferably to
non‑profit making health institutions in rural areas and small cities for
purchase of medicines, land, construction of building, purchase of equipment
further, etc. not exceeding 1/3rd of total cost as a grant and 1/3rd as a loan
while the remaining amount shall be borne by the Organization/Institution.
(c) Give loans to such health
institutions working on commercial basis (rural areas and small cities) to the
extent of 1/3rd of the total cost whereas 2/3rd of cost shall be borne by the
institution itself;
(d) Provide loans to doctors
for opening clinics preferably in rural areas and small cities;
(e) Assist the commercial/non‑commercial
institutions and doctors working in rural areas and small cities in getting
loans from scheduled banks and financial institutions;
(f) Grant scholarship, provide
facilities or otherwise assist in medical education, research and training;
(g) Lease plots or assist in
getting plots and land from Government, Development Authorities and Housing
Agencies controlled by the Government;
(h) Encourage in establishment
of non‑Government and non‑commercial organizations to achieve the
prescribed objectives of this Act;
(i) Encourage private sector
for providing necessary facilities for population welfare; and
(j) perform such other
functions as may be assigned to it by the Government.

Balochistan health foundation fund

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER V
FINANCE
14. Balochistan Health Foundation Fund.‑‑‑(1) There
shall be formed a fund to be known as the
Foundation Fund, which shall vest in the Foundation and shall be utilized by the Foundation to meet the charges in‑
connection with its functions under this Act.
(2) To the credit of the
Balochistan Health Foundation Fund, shall be placed‑
(a) grant made by Government
and the Federal Government;
(b) income from investments
made by the Foundation;
(c) donations and endowments;
(d) revolving funds placed by
the Government at the disposal of the Foundation;
(e) grant by the Local Bodies;
and
(f) all other sums received by
the Foundation and incomes from other sources.
(3) The fund shall be kept in
such custody and shall be utilized and regulated in such manner as may be
prescribed

Budget

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER V
FINANCE
15. Budget: ‑‑(1)
In the month of November each year, the Foundation shall submit to the
Government for approval a statement of the estimated receipt and expenditure in
rupees in respect of the next financial year.
(2) In the manners prescribed
by the Government, the Foundation shall also submit to the Government for
approval a statement of the estimated receipts and expenditure in foreign
exchange in respect of the next financial year.
(3) The Foundation shall obtain
specific sanction of the Government in respect of each individual scheme
costing Rs.10 lac each to be financed by the Foundation.

Audit and accounts

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER V
FINANCE
16. Audit and
Accounts.‑‑‑(1) The Foundation shall maintain proper
accounts and other relevant records and prepare annual statement of account,
including balance‑sheet in accordance with such general directions as may
be issued, and in such form as may be specified by Government.
(2) The accounts of the
Foundation shall be audited by two auditors who shall be Chartered Accountants
within the meaning of the Chartered Accountants Ordinance 1961 (X of 1961),
appointed by the Foundation with the approval of Government, on such
remuneration, to be paid by the Foundation as the Government may fix. '
(3) Notwithstanding the
provision of subsection (2) the Accountant- General, Balochistan, may, either
of his own motion or upon request received in this behalf from the Government
shall undertake such audit of the account books and connected documents at such
place or places as the Accountant- General, Balochistan may fix, and furnish
such explanations and information as the Accountant‑General, Balochistan
or an officer authorized by him in this behalf may ask for.
(4) Every auditor appointed
under subsection (2) shall be given a copy of the annual balance‑sheet of
the Foundation and shall examine it together with the accounts and vouchers
relating thereto and shall have a list delivered to him of all books kept by
the Foundation, and shall at all reasonable times have access to the books of
accounts and other documents of the Foundation and may in relaxation to such
accounts examine any officer of the Foundation.
(5) The auditor shall report to
the Government upon the annual balance‑sheet and accounts and in their
report state whether in their opinion the balance‑sheet is a full and
fair balance‑sheet containing all necessary particulars and properly
drawn‑up so as to exhibit a true and correct view of the state of the
Foundation's affairs and, in case they have called for any explanation or
information from the Board, whether it has been given and whether it is
satisfactory.
(6) The Government may at any
time issue directions to the auditors requiring them to report to it upon the
adequacy of measures 'taken by the Foundation for the protection of the
interests of the Government and of the creditors of the Foundation or upon the
sufficiency of their procedure in auditing the accounts of the Foundation and
may at any time enlarge or extend the scope of the audit or direct that a
different procedure in audit be adopted or that any other examination be made
by the auditors if in its opinion the public interest so requires.
(7) The Foundation shall comply
with every direction issued by the Government for the rectification of matters
objected to in audit.

Accounts

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER V
FINANCE
17. Accounts: ‑‑The Foundation shall,
with the prior approval of the Government, open an account in any Scheduled
Bank of Pakistan.

Penalty

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VI
PENALTY AND PROCEDURE
18. Penalty: ‑Whoever contravenes any provision
of this Act or any rule or regulation made or scheme sanctioned thereunder
shall, if no other penalty is provided for such contravention, be punishable
with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine, or
with both.
sections.punishment:
punishable
with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine, or
with both.

Cognizance of offences

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VI
PENALTY AND PROCEDURE
19. Cognizance of offences.‑‑No Court
other than a Court of Magistrate 1st Class shall take cognizance of any offence
punishable under this Act, on a complaint in writing made by the Foundation or
an officer/official authorized for the purpose by the Foundation.
sections.punishment:
punishable under this Act, on a complaint in writing made by the Foundation or
an officer/official authorized for the purpose by the Foundation.

sections.description:
Submission of yearly report and returns

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
20. Submission of yearly report and returns.‑‑‑(1)
The Foundation shall submit to the Government as soon as possible after the end
of every financial year but before the last day of December next following a
report on the conduct of its affairs for that year.
(2) The Government may, after
giving sufficient notice to the Foundation, require it to furnish the
Government with‑‑
(i) any return, statement,
estimates, statistics, or other information regarding any matter under the
control of the Foundation; or
(ii) a report on any subject
with. which the Foundation is concerned; or
(iii) a copy of any document in
the charge of Foundation and the Foundation shall comply with such requisition.

Board not responsible for certain acts of its officers and officials

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
21. Board not
responsible for certain acts of its officers and officials: ‑ The
Board shall not be responsible for any disfeasance, malfeasance and non feasance
of any officer or official appointed under this Act or of any person acting
under the authority or direction of or in subordination to any such officer or
official.

Power to dispose of land

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
22. Power to dispose of land.‑‑The
Foundation may retain, or may lease, sell, exchange, rent or otherwise dispose
of any land vested in it.

Power of foundation to make rules

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
23. Power of
Foundation to make rules.‑‑The Foundation may with the approval
of the Government, make rules for carrying out the purpose of this Act.

Control of Government over acts and proceedings of the board

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
24. Control of Government over acts and proceedings
of the Board: ‑‑All acts and proceedings of the Board shall be
subject to the control of the Government and the Government may suspend or
modify any such act or proceedings.

Dissolution of foundation and transfer of its assets and liabilities

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
25. Dissolution of Foundation and transfer of Its assets and liabilities.‑ Government
may, by notification in the official Gazette declare that the Foundation shall
be dissolved on such date as may be specified in such notification, and the
Foundation shall stand dissolved accordingly.
(2) On and from the said date‑‑ ,
(a)(i) all properties, funds
and dues placed at the disposal of the Foundation by Government; and
(ii) all properties, funds and
dues exchanged, derived from, or otherwise attributable to the properties,
funds and dues referred to in sub clause (1), which immediately before the said
date were held by or were realisable by the Foundation, shall vest in, and be
realisable by the Government;
(b) all properties, funds, and
dues, other than those referred to in clause (a), which immediately before the
said date, the Foundation shall vest in and be realisable by the Government may
determine, and its decision thereon shall be final;
(c) all liabilities which
immediately before the said date, were enforceable against the Foundation shall
be assumed by and be enforceable against the Government or such agency as the
Government determines under clause (b) as the case may be;
(d) for the purpose of
completing the execution of any scheme which has not been fully executed by the
Foundation and of realising properties, funds and dues re‑referred to in
clauses (a) and (b) as the case may be; and
(e) the agency referred in clauses
(b), (c), shall keep such accounts of all moneys, respectively received and
expended by it under this Act as the'' Government may prescribe.

Removal of difficulties

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
26. Removal of difficulties: ‑‑If any
difficulty arises in giving effect to any of the provisions of this Act
especially in respect of the adjustment of the power, functions and
jurisdiction of the Foundation under this Act, the Government may make such
order as may appear to it to be necessary or expedient for the purpose of
removing the difficulty.

Repeal

ACT I OF 1994
ACT I OF 1994
BALOCHISTAN HEALTH FOUNDATION
ACT, 1994
CHAPTER VII
MISCELLANEOUS
27. Repeal.‑The
Balochistan Health Foundation Ordinance, 1993 (IV of 1993), is hereby repealed.
